**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** • Be the trusted strategic finance partner to Category Directors, Commercial GMs and operational leaders. Convert financial and commercial insight into clear recommendations, constructively challenge decisions, and influence actions on investment, category performance and operating models. Success is measured by the quality and adoption of recommendations, not reporting timeliness alone. • Systems \& Tools • Advanced Excel; SAP ECC S4HANA or equivalent ERP; TM1, Anaplan, SAP SAC, OneStream or equivalent planning tools; Power BI, Tableau or equivalent reporting platforms. Comfortable using emerging AI enabled commentary and anomaly detection tools. • Finance Capability • Strong P\&L management, forecasting, budgeting, modelling, scenario and sensitivity analysis, business case development, promotional ROI and post implementation review. Retail commercial constructs are preferred.  

**What are we looking for?** • Qualifications • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Commerce. CA, CPA fully qualified or in final stages; postgraduate finance or commerce qualification preferred. • Experience • 10 to 15 years in Finance Business Partnering, FP\&A or commercial finance, including direct support to senior commercial, category or operational leaders. Proven experience owning reporting through executive presentation and delivering insight that influences decisions. Retail, wholesale, merchandise, CPG or another product driven environment is preferred.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** • 1\. Strategic Business Partnering \& Influence • Partner with senior business leaders as the Finance voice in trading, category, performance and leadership forums. • • Build trusted relationships while constructively challenging assumptions and bringing financial rigour to commercial decisions. • • Communicate complex analysis in plain language, adapting from detailed working level discussion to executive recommendation. • • Mentor team members and provide quality oversight across the Business Partnering Pod. • 2\. Commercial Insight \& Performance Management • Own end to end performance reporting and present the drivers, implications, risks, opportunities and recommended actions behind the numbers. • • Generate proactive insight on margin, promotional performance, channel mix, volume and category contribution. • • Lead root cause reviews, quantify risks and opportunities, track KPIs, and support timely mitigation or value realisation. • 3\. Planning, Forecasting \& Investment Decisions • Drive rolling forecasts, quarterly outlooks and annual planning, ensuring commercially grounded assumptions and complete risks and opportunities. • • Develop and challenge business cases through scenario modelling, sensitivity analysis and an independent financial perspective. • • Lead post implementation reviews to assess benefits realisation against approved commitments. • 4\. Category, Supplier \& Process Partnership • Provide profitability and margin input to range, space and category decisions; track supplier rebates, cost price negotiations and terms compliance. • • Challenge trading decisions where evidence indicates margin dilution. • • Simplify reporting, improve planning processes and use automation, Compass and modern platforms to increase speed and accuracy. • SUCCESS MEASURES • Forecast accuracy for revenue and margin within the agreed tolerance band. • • Commercial recommendations and promotional investments supported by clear evidence

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and effectively engage senior internal and external stakeholders . Demonstrated ability to identify cross-cutting and systemic risk themes and drive enterprise-level or business-wide control improvements. title: Travel Operations Manager
description:

 Experience: 5+ Years

 Job Type: Full-Time
 Work Mode: Work from Office About the Role We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Travel Operations Manager with 5+ years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of tour packages, DMC operations, destinations, travel costing, and end-to-end tour operations , along with excellent communication and business development skills. Key Responsibilities Manage and oversee day-to-day travel and tour operations . Design and develop customized domestic and international tour packages . Prepare detailed itineraries based on client requirements, budget, and preferences. Have strong knowledge of DMCs (Destination Management Companies) and their services, including hotels, transfers, sightseeing, activities, guides, and other destination-related arrangements. Maintain and develop strong relationships with DMCs, hotels, transport providers, suppliers, and travel partners . Have comprehensive knowledge of major domestic and international destinations , including attractions, hotels, activities, transportation, seasonality, and travel requirements. Prepare accurate tour costing including accommodation, transfers, sightseeing, meals, activities, flights, taxes, service charges, and other applicable costs. Negotiate with DMCs and vendors to obtain competitive rates and maximize profitability. Review and optimize package costing and pricing before sharing quotations with clients. Develop and implement effective business development strategies to generate new leads and business opportunities. Handle travel enquiries, prepare quotations, follow up with clients, and support conversion. Coordinate the complete tour execution process from booking confirmation to trip completion. Resolve operational issues and customer concerns efficiently. Monitor vendor performance and ensure quality service delivery. Stay updated with new destinations, tourism trends, travel regulations, visa requirements, hotel rates, and DMC offerings. Maintain accurate records of bookings, quotations, costing, payments, and operational details. Monitor sales and operational performance and work towards achieving business targets. Required Skills 5+ years of experience in Travel & Tourism, Tour Operations, Travel Agency, DMC, or a related industry. Strong knowledge of tour package designing and itinerary planning . Excellent understanding of DMCs and destination services . Strong knowledge of domestic and international destinations . Expertise in tour costing, quotation preparation, pricing, and profit-margin calculation . Excellent verbal and written communication skills . Strong business development and client-handling skills . Good negotiation and vendor-management skills. Strong knowledge of hotels, transfers, sightseeing, activities, flights, and other travel components. Excellent coordination and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously. Strong leadership and team-management skills. Target-oriented and commercially focused approach. Education Bachelor’s degree in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Business Administration, or any relevant field preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have end-to-end knowledge of the travel business , from understanding destinations and DMCs to designing tour packages, preparing accurate costing, handling clients, negotiating with suppliers, and executing tours successfully. The candidate should also be capable of contributing to business growth through effective business development strategies.

title: International Operations Coordinator USA and INDIA with B1 B2 Visa
description:
ROLE SUMMARY 
 The selected candidate must be willing and able to divide their working time between India and the United States approximately six months in India and six months in the USAdepending on the company’s operational requirements. 
 During the U.S. assignment, the candidate will be responsible for organizing and coordinating warehouse operations, inventory management, order fulfillment, logistics, vendor communication, and operational reporting. The candidate will also participate in trade shows, coordinate product displays and show-floor activities, interact directly with customers, secure orders, and enter and process those orders accurately. Additional business and operational responsibilities may be assigned as required. 
 The candidate must be adaptable, highly organized, and willing to handle multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced working environment. A valid U.S. visa and appropriate authorization permitting employment in the United States are mandatory. Candidates already holding valid U.S. work authorization will be strongly preferred. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Coordinate daily business activities between the company’s India and U.S. operations. Work directly with the founders and senior management on international business-development projects. Coordinate with customers, vendors, consultants, logistics providers, and business associates in the United States. Travel to the United States for business meetings, conferences, negotiations, site visits, and other legally permitted business activities. Maintain clear communication and timely execution across different time zones. Prepare reports, presentations, business correspondence, schedules, and follow-up records. Monitor assigned projects and ensure that tasks are completed within the agreed timelines. Represent the company professionally during domestic and international meetings. Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive company and business information. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Any bachelor’s degree; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Three to ten years of relevant professional experience. Excellent written and spoken English. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and standard business applications. Excellent coordination, reporting, organizational, and follow-up skills. Ability to travel frequently between India and the United States. A valid U.S. B-1/B-2 visa is strongly preferred. Candidates with prior experience living, traveling, or conducting business in the United States will be given preference. Candidates must comply with all applicable U.S. immigration and employment requirements. Any work requiring U.S. employment authorization may be performed only by individuals holding valid authorization. 
 IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, dependable, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with senior leadership. The person should have a practical, hands-on approach and be capable of independently managing international coordination assignments. 
 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS Competitive fixed salary Performance-based incentives Company-paid approved business-travel expenses Airfare, accommodation, local transportation, and applicable daily allowances Significant opportunities for career growth and expanded responsibilities 
 INDUSTRY Furniture, Furnishings, International Trade and Business Operations 
 FUNCTIONAL AREA International Operations, Business Coordination and Founder’s Office
